comment: Boot phase marks for the stock NAND image. Ranges are guest PC ranges that fire on entry, in order; 'after' arms a mark only once another has fired. main-display is a firmware address, not proof the UI is drawn; main-frame is: the first complete panel frame after main-display whose RGB565 bytes match the reference. 'read' entries copy guest memory when a mark fires; 'probes' (captured only with --profile-probes) record registers and memory at a block entry. The three VDK probes are the context-switch paths: 'current' is the running-thread pointer in L1, already the new thread at each probe, and TCB+0xc holds the priority in its low byte (0x14914 main 25, 0x1324 FIR fill 1, 0x38f0c periodic 29).
